proves: The shipped ProgramElementReadService and PeSnapshotGateService route a synthetic canary tenant through a populated active snapshot.

The rollback pauses side-effect draining and produces no unsuppressed rollback notification.
The emergency process switch forces the same canary tenant to the synthetic legacy reader without reading snapshot rows.
